regressionLikelihood.rationale: No source-visible defect was found: all thirteen Go afterimages match the official Linux normal formatter patch, parser positives and negatives are strict, and exact closures recompute. Exact-head Go/gofmt/CI execution remains absent.

regressionProtection.rationale: 342/342 pure-CPU models pass, the actual 39-row Linux log replays byte-exactly, official format afterimages and all source pins are closed. Compilation, formatting recheck, ordinary Go execution, and fresh readback have not run on the integrated head.

recoverability.rationale: The change is a source-only formatter/parser/pin delta with no migration or persistent state. Root can revert the single integration commit before any promotion.

confidence.rationale: The exact patch, 17 paths, 508 preimage compatibility, 19 authoritative chunk identities, official 13-file formatter transformation, parser control flow, actual Linux log, source contract, historical pins, and declared CPU suites were independently inspected.

applicability.rationale: The 508 dedicated P207A lane actually failed before Go on the old inventory regex, while independent 480 Linux evidence produced the exact thirteen-file gofmt patch transferred here.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Candidate Go bytes must be exactly the formatter outputs observed on the immutable 480 Linux source, without semantic additions.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Manually approximating only the two initially highlighted files or altering a formatter hunk could leave drift or introduce semantics.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The exact official normal gofmt.patch applies cleanly to 480 and its resulting blobs equal all thirteen candidate files; normal and diagnostic evidence agree on ordered changes.

materialBoundaries.invariant: The gate accepts all and only the exact 39 successful expected unittest rows across standard Class.method and required legacy Class-only forms.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Ignoring the trailing method, accepting a mismatched method, or count-only checking could substitute or duplicate results.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The regex backreference binds an optional trailing method to the leading test name, recognized rows must equal the exact sorted expected set and total result-line count, and duplicate/skip/extra/missing/mismatch negatives fail.

materialBoundaries.invariant: The parser fix must accept the captured run 40367880744 log without inventing rows.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: A synthetic-only parser could still reject the actual unittest rendering or accept an alias.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The frozen 5301-byte log produces exactly 39 unique names with the pinned digest and passes final Ran/OK/no-skip checks.

materialBoundaries.invariant: All format-induced content hashes propagate while historical trust anchors and test/budget semantics remain fixed.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Updating only the dedicated changedGo map could make downstream readers stale or silently rewrite OLD_V5.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Exact source contract recomputes module825, changed24, tops486/481, foundation689/previous688; 342 CPU models pass and OLD_V5/BOUND/Completion policy pins are unchanged.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Parser repair must not weaken runner-local raw streams, exact upload allowlists, or capture-first/final-strict ordering.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Restoring raw failure uploads or early formatting rejection could leak output or suppress Go evidence.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Workflow delta changes parser invocation and hashes only; existing privacy/capture negatives remain in the passing 39-model suite.

materialBoundaries.invariant: Integrated Linux head must format cleanly, compile, pass ordinary 481-top execution, and fresh-read identically.
materialBoundaries.counterexample: Static formatter provenance cannot prove compile or build-tag selection.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: Pinned workflow/readers are present but the post-integration run has not occurred.
